'''Arch Haven''' or '''Arch-Haven'''<ref>''[[Guide to Minecraft Dungeons: A Handbook for Heroes]]''</ref> is the second [[MCD:Mainland|mainland]] [[MCD:Secret Mission|secret mission]]. It is unlocked after collecting the [[MCD:Scroll|scroll]] found in [[MCD:Mystery Ship|Mystery Ship]] and completing {{MCD|Pumpkin Pastures}}. Completing Arch Haven does not unlock any missions.

== Appearance and description ==
{{Quote|'''ARCH-HAVEN''' – Once you've passed through Pumpkin Pastures, you can visit Arch-Haven - a coastal settlement at the edge of the pastures. You will begin on a ship and will need to battle your way across the beach, where the Illagers have made themselves quite at home. You must find a series of spell books situation on stole pinths throughout. There is also a cave to explore before you head back to the ship and sail away to safety.|''Guide to Minecraft Dungeons:<br>A Handbook for Heroes''}}
Arch Haven is a coastal archipelago located in the ocean south-east of Pumpkin Pastures. It contains a harbor with a beach house, a small village with three spellbooks, and a cave with a long wooden boardwalk. It features ships, acacia huts, campfires, banners, barrels, market stalls, small islands with stone ruins, and equipment stolen from farmers of Pumpkin Pastures by the [[MCD:Illager|Illagers]].<ref name="article">Mojang, ''[[Featured Mission: Arch Haven]]'', [[MCD:Nintendo Switch News|Nintendo Switch News]] (Posted under ''Minecraft Dungeons''), March 8, 2024</ref> The spawn area of the mission takes place on a small ship, the [[MCD:Small Ship|same ship found in Pumpkin Pastures]] after having been used to travel to Arch Haven by the heroes. After crossing the beach and reaching the harbor, a certain amount of mobs must be defeated for the gate blocking the harbor to be opened. North-east of the harbor, a village can be reached that was once a thriving trading hub before the Illagers invaded<ref name="article"/>. In this village, three spellbooks must be collected from atop three stone plinths in order to proceed further north towards the entrance of [[MCD:Arch Haven Cave|Arch Haven Cave]]. Upon exiting Arch Haven Cave, an [[MCD:Arena Battle|ambush]] of mobs must be defeated to lower the gate that prevented access to a large ship. The ship can be used to sail away to safety, ending the mission.

== Unlocking ==
The entrance [[MCD:Door|door]] of [[MCD:Mystery Ship|Mystery Ship]], the [[MCD:Sub Dungeon|sub dungeon]] where Arch Haven's scroll is found, always spawns in Pumpkin Pastures during the following objective: "'''The Last Hearth:''' Find the Village"

== Trivia ==
* The beach house in this mission plays a unique music track when the hero is near it. Its music track is played a 70% speed in-game.
* The song [[Minecraft Dungeons (Original Game Soundtrack)|Haven]] used in this mission is a slowed down version of the song [[Minecraft Dungeons (Original Game Soundtrack)|Squid Coast]].
